'''Dragon beasts''', also known as '''Muunilinst lizards''', were six-legged, four-eyed scavenging lizards dwelling in the impoverished sections of the [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. They were small, nearly as large as a [[Human/Legends|Human]] foot, red-orange in color, and feeding on the piles of garbage piled on every corner of the cities, like [[Pilaan]]. During the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fordo]] shot the ground in front of one in the [[City/Legends|city]] streets of [[Harnaidan]] to spook it off, sending it scrambling away in terror.
